department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (Molinaroli College of Engineering and Computing)

deadline.value: Fall preferred deadline is May 1; international applicants should finish three months before.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is required for all PhD entrants.
gre_general.quote: The general Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is required for all students entering the Ph.D. degree program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The pages reviewed do not state funding terms.

entry_route.value: Exceptional students may enter the PhD from a B.S.; others generally need to exceed master's-level requirements.
entry_route.quote: Exceptional students may be eligible to enter directly the Ph.D. degree program with a B.S. degree in civil engineering or closely related engineering field

also.quote: Ph.D. applicants without a master’s degree must generally exceed the minimum GPA and test score requirements for the master’s degree programs
